title: The Donkey in the Court

keywords: the blind men and the elephant? no - the donkey in the court
full_text:
When an arrogant governor brought his prized hunting hound into court to intimidate the judge, Nasruddin brought his gray donkey right into the courtroom and tied it to the judge's bench.

"Why do you bring a beast of burden into the hall of justice?" demanded the governor.

"To ensure a fair balance, Your Excellency!" smiled Nasruddin. "You brought a creature that bites, so I brought a creature that brays. Now the court is equally represented by beasts and men!"
moral: True justice treats all parties without fear of power or pretense.
